default.$description: Fill for primary buttons and coral callouts.

pressed.$description: Primary fill while pressed. Kept light enough for ink text to stay above 4.5:1.

disabled.$description: Primary fill when the control is disabled.

muted.$description: Secondary text such as metadata and captions.

disabled.$description: Text of disabled controls only. Below 4.5:1, which WCAG allows for inactive components.

link.$description: Inline links. A darker coral than the primary fill so it reads at 4.5:1 on every light surface.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill.

soft.$description: Slightly raised band on the canvas.

strong.$description: The darkest light surface, for selected or pressed areas.

default.$description: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative, so it has no contrast requirement.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus outline. Above 3:1 on every light surface, as WCAG requires for focus indicators.

teal.$description: Category marks. Below 3:1 on light surfaces, so never the only way to convey meaning.

amber.$description: Category marks. Below 3:1 on light surfaces, so never the only way to convey meaning.

success.$description: Success marks. Below 3:1 on light surfaces, so pair it with text or an icon.

warning.$description: Warning marks. Below 3:1 on light surfaces, so pair it with text or an icon.

error.$description: Error marks and messages. Reads at 4.5:1 on every light surface.
